strings.zh: 你怎么了？你现在不是{NEWLINE}和我在同一楼吗？{SCROLL}那就直接和我见面吧。
strings.en: What’s wrong? Aren’t we on the same{NEWLINE}floor right now?{SCROLL}Why not talk in person?

strings.zh: 告诉你件很有意思的事。{NEWLINE}前段时间我和别人{CLEAR}交换了猫头鹰,{SCROLL}可那个猫头鹰{NEWLINE}居然是我很久以前{CLEAR}和别的训练师{CLEAR}交换掉的！{SCROLL}它转辗地最后又回到了{CLEAR}我的身边。{SCROLL}这世界还真是小啊！
strings.en: Let me tell you something interesting.{SCROLL}A while ago, I received a Noctowl in a{NEWLINE}trade.{SCROLL}It turned out to be a Noctowl I had{NEWLINE}traded to another Trainer long ago!{SCROLL}After passing from hand to hand, it{NEWLINE}found its way back to me.{SCROLL}It’s a small world after all!

strings.zh: 好奇怪啊,{NEWLINE}前几天和别人{CLEAR}交换了猫头鹰之后,{SCROLL}总感觉这个猫头鹰{NEWLINE}有似曾相识似的感觉。{SCROLL}我突然想起来这是我以前{NEWLINE}培养起来的猫头鹰！{SCROLL}经过一番辗转之后{NEWLINE}又回到了我身边⋯⋯{CLEAR}我差点感动得想哭⋯⋯{CLEAR}可仔细一看,{CLEAR}这个猫头鹰我完全不认识。{SCROLL}哈哈,{NEWLINE}哪有这种离奇的事啊！
strings.en: How strange... A few days{NEWLINE}ago, I received a Noctowl{CLEAR}in a trade with someone.{SCROLL}Somehow that Noctowl felt so familiar.{SCROLL}Then it hit me: it was the{NEWLINE}Noctowl I had raised long ago!{SCROLL}After all its travels, it had found{NEWLINE}its way back to me... I was nearly{CLEAR}moved to tears... But when I{CLEAR}looked closer, I had never seen{CLEAR}that Noctowl before in my life.{SCROLL}Ha ha, as if something so{NEWLINE}far-fetched could really happen!

strings.zh: 我去抓{NEWLINE}野生精灵的时候,{CLEAR}几乎都没有成功过。{SCROLL}前几天又让{NEWLINE}小拉达给跑掉了⋯⋯{SCROLL}还是在我脱掉帽子{NEWLINE}毕恭毕敬行礼的时候{CLEAR}跑掉的。{SCROLL}野生的小拉达{NEWLINE}真是没礼貌⋯⋯
strings.en: Whenever I try to catch a wild Pokémon,{NEWLINE}I almost never succeed.{SCROLL}A few days ago, a Rattata got away from{NEWLINE}me again...{SCROLL}and right while I was taking off my hat{NEWLINE}and bowing to it respectfully.{SCROLL}Wild Rattata are so rude...

strings.zh: 哈哈,还想和我来一场{NEWLINE}对战吗？{SCROLL}好！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你！
strings.en: Ha ha, would you like to battle again?{NEWLINE}I think that’s a fine idea!{SCROLL}I’ll meet you at {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你怎么了？{NEWLINE}不会是忘了我们的约定了吧？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你来对战,{CLEAR}别忘了！
strings.en: Is everything all right?{NEWLINE}Did you forget about our appointment?{SCROLL}I’m waiting at {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}I will see you there!

strings.zh: 和你这样的年轻人{NEWLINE}通电话就可以{CLEAR}互相交换情报,{SCROLL}而且通过精灵,{NEWLINE}人和人之间的距离{CLEAR}也被拉近了。{SCROLL}精灵真是一种{NEWLINE}神奇的生物啊⋯⋯
strings.en: Chatting on the phone with a young{NEWLINE}person such as yourself lets us{CLEAR}trade all sorts of information.{SCROLL}And through Pokémon, people{NEWLINE}grow closer to one another.{SCROLL}Truly, Pokémon are{NEWLINE}extraordinary creatures...
